reference_basis.instruction: Preserve visible facial structure, freckles, muted eye appearance, and medium-brown hair family. The gathered hairstyle and waist-up leaning pose do not establish natural hair length or full-body proportions. Exclude chef clothing, apron, kitchen context, work pose, and lens perspective.

face_geometry.description: Long oval-to-angular face with high prominent cheekbones, moderate cheek width, a clearly defined lower jaw, and firm rounded-square chin. Strong and feminine, never gaunt or severe.

eyes.description: Pale muted green-grey eyes with a softly almond shape, modest lid exposure, and a steady gaze. Warm kitchen light makes the exact iris hue uncertain.

brows.description: Thick medium-to-dark brown brows set relatively low, mostly straight with a restrained outer arch and natural dense texture.

nose.description: Straight prominent medium-long nose with defined bridge and softly squared-to-rounded tip. Maintain projection and length.

mouth.description: Medium-wide mouth with a restrained upper lip, fuller lower lip, softly defined cupid's bow, and composed resting corners.

skin.description: Fair neutral skin with rosy cheeks and nose, subtle freckles across the central face and arms, visible pores, and light natural warmth.

hair.description: Medium-brown hair with slight natural wave and loose face-framing strands. The reference shows it gathered up, so natural length and usual arrangement are uncertain; do not lock the updo.

body_proportions.description: Canonical baseline is tall and sturdy-softly athletic. The leaning waist-up reference shows capable forearms but cannot verify stature or full-body proportions.
